title: Retrieve a parts box from a remote-release tool cabinet
instruction: Open cabinet A's right door and put the blue parts box behind it upright on the table outside the cabinet; let go and leave it stable for20seconds. Do not slam any door or sustain wrist overload.
context: Maintenance access to a parts cabinet with side paddle release: release the rotary latch, swing its door clear, then extract a loose box without damaging the enclosure.
setup: Two fixed grey rigid steel-like cabinets360W x180D x500H mm, each with two176W x478H x12D mm hinged door panels, round pull shafts30mm diameter and40mm stand-off with44mm end caps; two sprung side paddles; two loose50x50x60mm .31kg tabbed parts boxes per cabinet. Cabinet front centres(.25,-.29,.7475)m and(.33,.30,.7475)m, both yaw0. Cabinet A negativeY, blue target behind its right door. Inventory.json gives every primitive, pose, mass/material estimate and spring. Right YAM base(0,-.305,1.10)m on120x120x352.5mm support; left(-.08,-.50,1.00)m on120x120x252.5mm support. Both upright and fixed. Table top.7475m. Fixed source42 physical properties for every harness seed.
scoring: Draft numeric rubric: persistent0 for any knob/frame impact>0.25m/s or untared wristforce>80N continuously0.1s. Otherwise0.25 if target rear-paddle release occurred and rightdoor angle>=7degrees;0.5 if target box centre height777.5+/-4mm, uprightwithin15degrees, combined linear/angular speednorm<=.05, centre outside cabinet exclusion rectangle localx(-.02,.20)m and abs(localy)<.20m, complete box/tab envelope over table, physical tablecontact, and no robotcontact;1.0 once all box conditions hold continuously20s. Remaining outcomes0. Final score, never best. Floor/offtable/held/moving box cannot fullscore. Credit channel remains disabled in this preparation until actual runtime validation.
